questions.question: What is the core invariant of a production document parsing system?
options: Every extracted claim remains traceable to its source region, parser identity, and validation result
Every page must run through OCR even when a reliable text layer exists
Every document type must use one universal model
Every output must be flattened into plain text
questions.explanation: Traceability lets software and reviewers verify where a value came from, reproduce the parse, and understand why it was released.

questions.question: A digital contract has a reliable native text layer and simple geometry. What is the best starting route?
options: Native text and coordinates with structural checks and targeted fallback
OCR every page and discard native text
Extract only page screenshots
Skip coordinates because the text is copyable
questions.explanation: A trustworthy native layer is usually the least expensive transcription source, but reading order, hierarchy, provenance, and unsupported regions still need checks.

questions.question: Why can a high confidence score fail to protect an invoice workflow?
options: The parser can be highly confident about a plausible but incorrect digit
Confidence automatically verifies line-item reconciliation
Confidence proves that the source file is safe
Confidence guarantees correct table headers
questions.explanation: Confidence estimates model certainty. Deterministic invariants such as line sums and account checks test correctness from independent evidence.

questions.question: Which representation best preserves a table with merged headers?
options: A cell graph containing row, column, span, header, and source-coordinate relationships
One whitespace-separated string per page
A screenshot without extracted coordinates
Only the highest-confidence cell
questions.explanation: Merged headers govern multiple cells. Explicit relationships preserve that meaning and make validation possible.

questions.question: A parser has excellent word accuracy but interleaves two columns. Which evaluation area exposes the failure most directly?
options: Reading order and layout structure
File upload throughput only
Character accuracy only
Document hash length
questions.explanation: The words may all be correct while their sequence is wrong. Layout regions and reading-order metrics isolate that failure.

questions.question: What should happen when a payment-critical total fails line-item reconciliation?
options: Block or review it according to a declared fail-closed policy
Accept it whenever OCR confidence is above 90 percent
Delete the source coordinates
Average it with the invoice identifier confidence
questions.explanation: A failed independent invariant is stronger evidence of danger than a high model confidence is evidence of correctness.
